summary: HumanPlay-3R repaired MainMenu layout, pause camera time handling, demo startup ownership, and build scene order.

checks.name: MainMenu opens
checks.evidence: MainMenu.unity loaded and play-mode runtime UI built without console errors.

checks.name: Main menu buttons are centered and not shifted too low
checks.evidence: MainMenuController now uses a centered 760x620 panel and VerticalLayoutGroup for 440x70 buttons.

checks.name: Settings popup layout is correct
checks.evidence: Settings popup uses vertical layout plus horizontal rows for Volume slider and Fullscreen toggle; Back button is below controls.

checks.name: Start Demo loads HumanPlay_Demo_PlayerVsAI
checks.evidence: SceneFlowController still loads HumanPlay_Demo_PlayerVsAI and build settings include the demo scene.

checks.name: Demo scene does not start old Agent vs Bot flow
checks.evidence: Bootstrap auto-start and scripted opponent stepping are disabled; EpisodeController auto-start is disabled.

checks.name: Correct AIvsPlayer2 flow active automatically or no match until Start
checks.evidence: Runtime smoke showed HumanPlayModeController CurrentMode=AIvsPlayer2 and HumanSide=Player2.

checks.name: Player2 is not controlled by bot
Player2 control works after correct start
checks.evidence: Runtime smoke showed HumanPlayerController.IsHumanControlActive=true and selected Player2 unit.

checks.name: Pause does not block camera movement
checks.evidence: RtsCameraController movement and smoothing use Time.unscaledDeltaTime.

checks.name: WASD works while paused
checks.evidence: WASD input path is independent of Time.timeScale and only blocks for focused input fields.

checks.name: Mouse wheel zoom works while paused
checks.evidence: Zoom smoothing uses Time.unscaledDeltaTime; scroll input remains read while paused unless pointer is over UI.

checks.name: Esc opens pause menu
checks.evidence: HumanPlayCanvasController Escape pause menu path was preserved.

checks.name: Main Menu button returns to MainMenu
checks.evidence: SceneFlowController restores Time.timeScale and loads MainMenu.

checks.name: Time.timeScale restored after menu transitions
checks.evidence: SceneFlowController sets Time.timeScale=1 before scene loads and quit/restart paths.

checks.name: Build Settings: MainMenu index 0, demo index 1
checks.evidence: Unity build settings report MainMenu buildIndex=0 and HumanPlay_Demo_PlayerVsAI buildIndex=1.

checks.name: No new C# errors
checks.evidence: Unity console error query returned zero errors after compile and smoke checks.

checks.name: No New Input System legacy warnings
checks.evidence: No legacy Input warnings were observed in MainMenu or demo smoke checks.

checks.name: No Python/training/checkpoint/action contract changes
checks.evidence: No action contract files were edited. A runtime-generated Python report change from smoke testing was restored; pre-existing dirty Python files remain unchanged by this repair.
